basic_profile.bio: An experienced wedding videographer from Portland, Oregon, I've been capturing special moments professionally for over a decade. I’m passionate about filmmaking and dabble in photography. When I’m not working, I enjoy hiking the trails of the Pacific Northwest and exploring new music scenes. I typically browse Reddit during the late evenings after a long day of editing. Currently, I’m in a committed relationship and we love to travel and attend live events together. I’m also a huge advocate for mental health awareness and often engage in discussions around this topic.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Film Studies and years of on-the-job experience, my expertise lies in video production. I started my career as a photographer and naturally transitioned into videography. Self-taught in many technical aspects, I stay updated with the latest trends and equipment through online courses and forums.
